ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive network of white linear filaments and irregular high-contrast geometric blobs distributed over a dark pixel field; contiguous white intensity is higher at the median base and trailing edge margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency jagged boundary with pixel-amplitude variations of 3-10 pixels along the continuous linear edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep of the lateral fluke margins terminating in acute, upward-oriented tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of circular high-contrast white pixels distributed near the outer tips and inner trailing edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High-density detection of multi-directional, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated on the central regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white linear scarring and pigmentation disruptions covering over 60% of the visible fluke surface.
